extraction.notes: No identifiable summer camp program or 2026 or 2027 camp details were found on the official website or in official-site search results. Third-party directories mention summer camps but do not establish a program name or reliable seasonal details, so no card was created. Direct opens of the home and Events & News pages returned no readable text; search results were readable. The Events & News search result includes an unrelated Swimtastic La Vista, Nebraska portal, which should not be used for this provider.
